ETL aggregate 2 luồng độc lập: buy_agg (GROUP BY trd_dt + buy side CASE WHEN) và sell_agg (GROUP BY trd_dt + sell side CASE WHEN) rồi FULL OUTER JOIN theo ivsr_grp_code × trd_dt. Buy side: CASE WHEN scr_trd.buy_frgn_ivsr_tp_code IN ('10','20') AND scr_trd.buy_ivsr_tp_code = '8000' THEN 'FOREIGN_INDIVIDUAL' / IN ('10','20') AND <> '8000' THEN 'FOREIGN_INSTITUTIONAL' / = '00' AND = '8000' THEN 'INDIVIDUAL' / = '00' AND <> '8000' THEN 'INSTITUTIONAL'. Sell side: tương tự dùng sell_frgn_ivsr_tp_code + sell_ivsr_tp_code
etl_logic: LOOKUP ivsr_grp_dim.ivsr_grp_dim_id WHERE ivsr_grp_dim.ivsr_grp_code = ivsr_grp_code [từ FULL OUTER JOIN buy_agg và sell_agg]
